decisions.reason: Its demonstrated use by a major government customer and integration with more than 30 APIS schemes keeps performance clearly above aspiration, so we retain it.

After two years without clear evidence of uptake and with travel-health demand looking less central to our core security trajectory, results appear below aspiration and the resources are better redeployed.
The module fits our training capabilities and existing client base, and with organisational slack we would continue it as a relatively low-cost cross-sell despite limited visible results.
It still matches our integrated security innovation agenda and could yet find use with current customers, but weak public evidence means it remains under close review against aspiration.
The platform is closely aligned with our airport and border-related offer and complements adjacent products, so we keep it while expecting further commercialisation.
